findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded in controller requests, breaking fallbacks in background jobs and mailers
findings.body: Because `translate_accelerator.rb` lazily loads locale YAML files and `I18n.translate` only calls `load_locale(config.locale)` for the primary locale, fallback locales must be explicitly loaded via `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` before `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` looks up keys in the backend. Calling `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` only in `ApplicationController#set_locale` means any translation performed outside a controller request (such as in Sidekiq jobs, mailers, rake tasks, or specs) or when `I18n.t(..., locale: ...)` is called with an explicit locale will not have the fallback locales (`SiteSetting.default_locale` and `:en`) loaded into the backend, causing fallback lookups to miss and return `translation missing` even when the key exists in the fallback locale.

findings.title: Pluralization and Fallbacks are included in incompatible order and on different target classes
findings.body: Line 5 includes `I18n::Backend::Pluralization` into `I18n::Backend::Simple`, and line 9 then includes `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` into `I18n.backend.class`. In Ruby, the last included module is placed first in the method lookup chain (`ancestors`). For `I18n::Backend::Pluralization` to work with `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` when a pluralization rule (`i18n.plural.rule`) is defined in the locale or a fallback locale, `Pluralization` must be included after `Fallbacks` (or `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` / `pluralize` will be bypassed or resolved in the wrong order). Additionally, if `I18n.backend` is ever replaced with a new `I18n::Backend::Simple.new` instance (e.g., in tests), `Fallbacks` is included on the current backend's class while `Pluralization` is hardcoded to `I18n::Backend::Simple`.

findings.title: `@loaded_locales` can be `nil` in `I18n.translate` before `ensure_loaded!` is ever called
findings.body: `ensure_loaded!` initializes `@loaded_locales ||= []`, whereas `translate` at line 68 calls `@loaded_locales.include?(config.locale)` directly without initializing `@loaded_locales`. Previously `@loaded_locales` was only initialized in `reload!`. If `I18n.t` is called before `reload!` or `ensure_loaded!` has run, `@loaded_locales` is `nil` and line 68 raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'include?' for nil:NilClass`. `translate` should call `ensure_loaded!(config.locale)` (or `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!`) instead.

findings.title: Translation cache key does not include `SiteSetting.default_locale`, serving stale fallback translations when default locale changes
findings.body: `I18n.translate` caches zero-argument translations under `k = "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"`. With `FallbackLocaleList`, the result of translating a key for a user locale `L` now depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale` whenever `L` is missing the key. If `SiteSetting.default_locale` is changed (e.g., in multisite requests or when an admin updates the setting), the LRU cache will continue returning the translation from the previous default locale.
